title: Chapter 1272
text:
Everyone looked in the direction of the voice and saw that the person who spoke was a tall and muscular male creature. His skin was dark, and he had long hair that was as wild as a lion's mane. He was standing with his arms crossed, looking straight at Han Xiao with a cold expression.

"Oh? Is that what you think? "

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and looked at him. This person's background appeared in his mind.

'Extreme Fist' Bagnita, an extremely powerful Pugilist. His Pugilist style was explosive, fierce, and destructive. He was the founder of many powerful Pugilist schools, especially the Extreme Path Style. Although he was not the founder of this school, he was recognized as the most proficient in the Extreme Path Style in history.

This guy was not someone from the Tragedy of the Pinnacles but a Beyond Grade A from an earlier period. He was from the Neutral Faction, and his cause of death was unknown. He left his family behind and was also in this batch of revivals.

Bagnita was wearing a sleeveless military uniform, and the muscles on his arms were pulsating. He coldly said, "What I hate the most is when people give me multiple choice questions. Whether I help you or not depends on my mood. If you want to force me, there's no need to talk about it!"

"People with personalities usually don't live long." Dylan sneered.

Hearing this, everyone could not help but look at him and nod in agreement.

Bagnita could not be bothered with him. He looked around at the people around him and said with a deep voice, "We're all Beyond Grade As. Who's afraid of who? If you have guts, stand beside me!"

Han Xiao shook his head. He realized that he was actually very calm, as if he had gotten used to it. If there came a day when Pugilists were not as stubborn as before, he might find it strange.

He turned around and looked at the revivals.

"Who else thinks so? You can all stand up."

Everyone looked at each other and hesitated for a while. No one responded. Instead, they all backed away and isolated Bagnita.

Seeing this, Bagnita frowned and coldly said, "Humph, the Beyond Grade As of the later generations are getting worse and worse!"

Dylan smacked his lips and retorted, "Heh, you're instigating us to play with our lives. If we fight, with your strength, there's an eighty percent chance you'll be able to escape unscathed. You won't be the one sacrificing anyway. If you want people to be cannon fodder, just say it. We're all professionals here. Who are you trying to show off to?"

"Idiot." Bagnita glanced at Dillon and said with disdain.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's gaze turned back to Bagnita, and he raised his brows.

"It seems like you're the only one left. Do you still want to continue?"

"Since no one dares to cooperate, what else is there to say?"

Bagnita snorted and put down his arms that were crossed in front of his chest.

Han Xiao couldn't help but laugh. "You know what's good for you, but don't you think you're dreaming? You want to incite the other revivors to riot with just a few words? When you see that things are not going to work, you just give up and pretend that nothing happened. How can there be such a good thing? "

Bagnita frowned and tightened his arm muscles. "What do you want?"

Han Xiao slowly walked into the group of revivors and approached Bagnita. As he walked, he spoke.

As he walked, he said, "We revived all of you for a mission that benefits the entire class, not for charity. I've already explained the situation very clearly just now. We're all comrades on the same battlefield … But even so, we didn't want to use you as cannon fodder. We didn't even force you to take the risk. We gave you the choice to stay in the Holy Covenant and watch us fight. If we win, you can enjoy it together. If we lose, you can continue to hide in the dark and protect yourselves.

"You can be ungrateful that we gave you a second life, but you didn't hesitate to destroy our overall plan for your personal needs … Of course, you have the freedom to do so, but since you've done so, don't blame us for dealing with you."

As soon as he finished speaking, something unexpected happened!

Violent energy surged out. Bagnita's fist was burning with dazzling Pugilist flames. It drew a meteor-like trajectory and hit Han Xiao's chest heavily!

Bang!

You know I'm a Pugilist, and you still dare to approach me. You're asking for a beating!

Such a thought flashed through Bagnita's mind. He was not going to sit still and wait for his death. Seeing that Han Xiao's words were not right, he decided to strike first.

The next moment, the fist energy suddenly exploded. Condensed Pugilist flames gushed out from Han Xiao's back and turned into an inverted cone-shaped energy shockwave, blasting a huge hole in the entire room.

Boom!

Looking from space, a dazzling beam of light suddenly shot out from a certain location in the galactic base, as if there was an internal explosion.

In the room, everyone was shocked by Bagnita's decisiveness. They all made their own moves. Some wanted to help, while others wanted to retreat and watch.

However, before they could do anything, they saw that Han Xiao, who took a heavy punch, did not even shake his body. As if nothing had happened, he counterattacked in a flash. He grabbed Bagnita's head with both hands, pressed it down, and raised his leg to knee Bagnita with great force!

Bang!

For a moment, Bagnita could not withstand this explosive force. His head was pressed down and came into close contact with Han Xiao's knee. Blood immediately gushed out of his nose, and his brain was concussed.

Before he could recover from the moment of dizziness, Han Xiao grabbed Bagnita's head with one hand and used his other hand to strike Bagnita's arched back.

Crack!

The sound of a spine cracking was clearly heard by everyone present. Bagnita's back was clearly bent.

"Hiss …"

Many people took a deep breath, and the way they looked at Han Xiao changed again.

After taking the first hit, he did not hesitate to exchange injury for injury and heavily injure his opponent … If someone said he was not a Pugilist, they would not believe it!

At this moment, Bagnita was freed from the temporary debuff. He let out an angry roar, and the aura around him exploded again. His muscles bulged, and a thick blood aura spread out. His attributes suddenly increased by a large margin.

Then, Bagnita hugged Han Xiao's waist and kicked his legs. With a burst of strength, he pushed Han Xiao through the metal walls and flew out like a meteor, falling into the universe.

"This is Extreme Channel Style!"

Everyone was knowledgeable, so they immediately understood Bagnita's change.

Relying on the special explosive power of Ultimate Dao-ryu, a Martial Artist's combat power could usually surpass a small level. Bagnita's name was very well-known. As the master of Ultimate Dao-ryu in history, the effects of Ultimate Dao-ryu were even more shocking. Moreover, under his exclusive modification, the side effects were limited.

Bagnita himself had not reached the peak Beyond Grade A level, but with his powerful explosive power, he was able to compete with peak Beyond Grade As and earned himself the nickname 'Extreme Channel Fist'. In everyone's eyes, he was very strong.

The expressions of the revivors changed. Although they had felt that Han Xiao's Energy Rank was very shocking, they had not seen Black Star fight, so they did not have a direct view of it.

Now that they had the chance, the revivors did not help or stop him. They all wanted to use this opportunity to observe Black Star's actual strength.

Most Beyond Grade As were proud people. The revivors present all wanted to see how strong this so-called 'Beyond Grade A Leader' was and how confident he was.

Many of the revivors had originally thought that they would be able to see a fierce battle, but the change in the situation in the next second was beyond their expectations.

Han Xiao also locked onto Bagnita. Then, Mechanical Force burst out of his body. At the same time, countless mechanical soldiers swarmed out of the galactic base, covering the sky. Without saying a word, they attacked the two of them fiercely!

Rumble —

The expanding energy ball was like a newborn star, instantly lighting up the entire galaxy!

The aftermath of the explosion spread out, and the protective shield of the galactic base was activated. The entire base was pushed away, shaking violently.

The sudden burst of light made everyone squint their eyes subconsciously, their faces filled with astonishment.

"Don't tell me the two of them died together?"

"That's too brutal. Aren't they afraid of losing?"

"Speaking of which, Black Star is actually a Mechanic? His physique is definitely that of a Pugilist no matter how you look at it! "

Everyone could not help but worry. They looked around, only to realize that every member of the Holy Covenant had a calm look on their faces, as though they were not worried at all.

"Aren't you worried about the safety of your partner?" someone could not help but ask.

Beiger turned around to look at these people, curled his lips, smiled, and said, "Heh, I'm afraid there's nothing that can kill Black Star!"

At this time, the light gradually shrunk. Two figures that were stuck close to each other flew out from the center of the explosion, quickly approached the base, and flew back into the room through the gap.

Plop!

The sound of someone falling to the ground could be heard. Bagnita laid on the ground like a dead dog. There was not a single piece of flesh on his body that was unharmed. He was heavily injured and on the verge of death.

Everyone was shocked. They looked up and saw that although Han Xiao was also injured, he was recovering at an unbelievable speed. In the blink of an eye, he had returned to his original state. It was him who had brought the dying Bagnita back.

Han Xiao looked calm and pointed at Oathkeeper with his lips.

"Treat his injuries. Don't let him die."

The members of the Holy Covenant were not surprised. A few of them walked forward, turned Bagnita's body around, and sprayed him with healing spray. It looked like they were brushing sauce on a barbecue.

Seeing this, the revivors could not believe their eyes.

That's it?

From the start to the end of the battle, it had not even been three minutes!

They had thought that it would be an intense battle, but no one had expected Black Star to kill Bagnita so easily …

This was not some random Beyond Grade A Super but a famous expert in history!

From the start, everyone knew that Black Star might be very strong, but they did not expect him to be this strong. This had completely exceeded their judgment!

No wonder he dares to call himself the 'leader of the Beyond Grade As'. He does have the right to do so … Many people were shocked.

Han Xiao stretched his neck and moved his muscles that were a little sore from the bombardment earlier. When he turned around and saw the fear in everyone's eyes, he nodded and was quite satisfied with the effect of this battle.

He was actually not angry. Scolding Bagnita was just an excuse to establish his dominance.

He knew that there were definitely many people who had similar thoughts. It was just that they did not dare respond because of the situation. To make these people give up on their thoughts, it was not enough to rely on the number of Beyond Grade As to make them hesitate. He also had to let them feel the huge difference in individual strength. As the saying went, seeing is believing. Only by directly attacking would he be able to give them the most direct impression.

And the best way to establish his dominance was to kill Bagnita instantly.

Therefore, Han Xiao purposely acted as if he wanted to attack while taking the initiative to approach him. This was to let Bagnita engage in close combat with him so that he could use 'Same Life as Heaven and Earth'. This move was the most efficient way to kill him instantly!

His biggest advantage was the disparity in intelligence. As long as someone knew his background, no one would dare approach him. However, these revivors did not know this. Therefore, Bagnita followed his old experience and did not let go of this' opportunity '. The first move was close combat, and he completely fell into Han Xiao's trap.

The moment Bagnita chose to fight, the result of this battle was already decided. Facing an opponent who did not know anything, 'Same Life as Heaven and Earth' was almost the best tactic.

The result of killing Bagnita within seconds was what Han Xiao had expected. It was a huge blow to the young minds of these people. There was only one last step left.

Seeing that Bagnita's body was slowly recovering, Han Xiao took out the Spacetime Amber and wrapped Bagnita up.

He said calmly, "I won't kill him, but to avoid any unstable factors, I'll lock him up and let him calm down."

The next moment, the Spacetime Amber was formed, and Bagnita's body was frozen in the amber.

"What's this?"

Everyone was confused, and the Holy Covenant members beside them began to explain.

Very soon, everyone present knew the function of the Spacetime Amber, and their expressions changed. They were shocked and afraid. This thing was the nemesis of almost all Beyond Grade As.

This time, Han Xiao turned to look at everyone and smiled kindly.

"The person who raised the problem has been dealt with. So, everyone, have you made your choice?"

Everyone had different expressions. Some smiled bitterly, while others swallowed their saliva.

Under the intense fear, there was no suspense in their choice.

"… I'm willing to stay in the Holy Covenant."

"Me too."

Since someone had started, the others followed suit.

Between the two paths, almost everyone chose to stay in the Holy Covenant organization. At least before they understood the situation, they did not want to appear in the outside world to avoid taking the risk.

Very soon, Dylan was the only one who did not express his opinion.

Han Xiao looked over. "What about you? Are you staying in the Holy Covenant or joining the association?"

Dillon stroked his smooth, fair chin and snorted.

"I don't want to miss such an interesting thing … I'm joining the association! If we fight with the three Universal Civilizations, count me in. I'm going to settle the score with them! "

As he spoke, Dylan did not seem to feel satisfied. He glanced at the other revivors present and said sarcastically, "The books are indeed correct.

"Sure enough, the books are right. Mediocre people who are afraid of everything always make up the majority.

Hearing this, Han Xiao could not help but take another look at Dylan.

You deserve to be crushed to death. Even I want to beat you to death …
